description: Implementation of MetalContext class managing Metal GPU device context, shader pipeline caching, and device capabilities for PyTorch's Metal backend.

classes.name: MetalContext
classes.description: Singleton class managing Metal GPU device, shader pipelines, and device info for PyTorch.

methods.name: sharedInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MetalContext.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Checks if Metal GPU device and shaders are available and supported on the current platform.

methods.name: pipelineState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a compute pipeline state for a given kernel name.

methods.name: specializedPipelineState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a specialized compute pipeline state with constants for a given kernel.

methods.name: emptyMTLBuffer
methods.description: Creates an empty Metal buffer of specified size.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns a string describing the device name and language version.

methods.name: _compileProgram
methods.description: Compiles Metal shader source code into a library, caching the result.
